sentences.japanese: 日本に住む外国人も、日本の法律に準じて裁かれる。
sentences.english: Foreigners who live in Japan are judged according to Japanese laws.

sentences.japanese: この投資案を実行するには、事業本部長、あるいはそれに準ずる役職以上の決裁が必要です。
sentences.english: This investment plan requires approval from the director of operations or someone of equally high status in order to execute.
